purpose: Give reviewers a conservative, machine-readable starting point for retrofitting the full module contract across the 30 legacy-baseline workbooks. This is an evidence-pointer audit, not a publication or pedagogical approval registry.

auditScope.selectionRule: The canonical graph marks these legacy-baseline modules as learner-material-ready. M25 and M26 are included because they remain reader-visible legacy-baseline workbooks, even though their route availability is preview-only.

truthBoundary.pointerResolutionOnly: A resolved Markdown anchor proves only that a Git-tracked local Markdown file and its visible h2/h3 heading exist in this revision. A graph field proves only that the named canonical graph field exists for the module.
truthBoundary.qualityReview: Every criterion below has humanQualityReview not-reviewed. No entry records pedagogical quality, accessibility quality, source-claim correctness, psychological safety, license sufficiency, or learner mastery.
truthBoundary.publication: This audit cannot change canonical graph lifecycle, reader access, route availability, v3 contract state, release evidence, deployment status, or the strict release gate. In particular, it does not make a legacy-baseline module contract-complete.
truthBoundary.ambiguity: ambiguous is intentional: a nearby heading or generic source route may exist, but this audit could not establish a contract-specific, reviewer-ready pointer without reading and approving the underlying material.
truthBoundary.provenance: This audit input is a deterministic, allowlisted release input whose canonical-LF SHA-256 is recorded in content/course/release-inputs.v1.json. That hash is not a release, publication, or human-approval claim.

statusVocabulary.pointer-present: A bounded structural pointer exists for the criterion. It is not a quality judgment or a claim that all contract sub-requirements are met.
statusVocabulary.ambiguous: Nearby or partial evidence exists, but the contract-specific evidence boundary is not yet explicit enough for this audit.
statusVocabulary.missing: No bounded module-specific evidence pointer was found in the reviewed workbook/source-map inputs. This is an audit finding, not a claim that the concept is absent everywhere in the product.
